title: Hokusai: Essential Vocabulary

description: The words you need to talk about Hokusai precisely.
key_points: Masterwork: The work a person is most remembered for.
Movement: The school or era they belonged to.
Influence: How later workers built on their ideas.
Contemporary: Someone living and working at the same time.
Legacy: What their work enables after them.
Breakthrough: The achievement that changed what was possible.
Apprenticeship: Learning under a master of the craft.
Patron: A supporter who funded the work.
Rivalry: Competition that sharpened both sides.
Revival: Later rediscovery of neglected work.
Fresco: Painting on wet plaster.
Oil: Slow-drying paint of the old masters.
Perspective: Drawing depth on a flat surface.
Chiaroscuro: Dramatic light against dark.

demo.program:
# Hokusai — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is Hokusai known for?", "The Great Wave"),
    ("What field did Hokusai work in?", "Ukiyo-e"),
    ("What is lived?", "1760-1849"),
    ("What is field?", "Ukiyo-e"),
    ("What is known for?", "The Great Wave"),
    ("What is note?", "Waves and Mount Fuji at 70+"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
